records.statement: BNY's support for XRP custody is an institutional product capability; no XRP-specific assets under custody, customer balances, net inflows or collateral utilization are disclosed.
BNY mint/redeem RLUSD through BNY and tokenized trade-finance plans are expressly future intentions subject to final BNY/regulatory approvals and client requirements.

C2FO Instant Pay is a limited rollout/waitlist. No actual XRPL settlement volume, named capital-provider commitment or deployed XRP amount is disclosed; C2FO's historical $520B+ Early Pay figure is not XRPL capital.
Bitnomial's XRP 40% haircut and $15M notional limit establish published eligibility only; no XRP collateral balance, utilization, customer or margin concentration is disclosed.
Ripple Prime product page says XRP can be posted as collateral, but supported jurisdiction, haircut, limits, eligible counterparty and actual utilization are not disclosed.
Ripple Prime's October RWA swap release specifies RLUSD collateral for that product; it must not be generalized into evidence that XRP is used in those RWA swap positions.
Standard Chartered RLUSD custody is live according to the bank, while LMAX collateral mirroring remains planned and conditional; the announcement does not establish XRP custody or XRP collateral.
Coinbase National Trust Company is recorded as approved/conditional, not consummated/effective in the reviewed OCC record; do not describe it as an operational national trust bank.
Circle and Ripple trust-bank applications show consummated/effective status, but actual commencement of all announced custody, reserve-management and collateral services has not been verified.
BNY is custodian of the Circle Reserve Fund, one component of Circle's reserve structure; this does not mean all USDC reserves are held at BNY.
Circle's $71B USDC circulation and $71.2B reserve snapshot is global, not XRPL-specific; the XRPL stablecoin panel is dominated by RLUSD and shows different 7-day and 30-day directions.
XRPL transaction and active-address counts do not establish economic throughput; automated and non-economic activity may be included, while DEX volume and TVL are separate measures.
CoinPaprika's XRP quote is timestamped 15:38 UTC and is stale relative to the 20:40 UTC cutoff; other provider windows must not be averaged without venue/time harmonization.

ETF flows are reconstructed from holdings deltas; GXRP is excluded from flow calculations due capture gaps, BITW rebalancing and fee accruals can affect deltas, and estimated cost basis is not investor-level realized P&L.
Ripple's $900M annualized product revenue run rate and transaction/partner figures are company-reported corporate metrics, not audited XRP purchases, XRP spot demand or posted collateral.

The rJqi→raRVLN→r39TA→Binance-labelled rNxp4h route is account-level tracing of fungible XRP. It does not prove the same XRP units moved end-to-end, that Ripple directed the later Binance transfers, or that any XRP was sold.

raRVLN is identified by XRPLWin as an AMM pool and as belonging to a vault and loan broker, but the AMM pair, vault identity, loan-broker identity and exact asset composition were not loaded because the explorer hit rate limits.

The 68.9246M XRP transfer to Binance-labelled rNxp4h is not proven to be incident replenishment. Binance's $1.34B market/OTC acquisition statement is not XRP-specific, and rNxp4h's activation by rDAE53 does not make it one of the five compromised wallets.
